module-files-rule.desc: Verifies that: - Folder modules use the `mod.rs` form (not the sibling-file form). - `mod.rs` and `lib.rs` files contain only `mod` and `use` statements. - `mod` statements are only in `mod.rs` and `lib.rs` files. - Every `use` statement in a non-`mod.rs`/`lib.rs` file is private.
module-files-rule.rationale: We want mod.rs files to be the place where module declarations and re-exports happen. And we want these files scoped to just that purpose.
